title: Bump @testing-library/user-event to 14.6.8 in console-ui
summary: A dependency-only change: the console-ui package's dev dependency @testing-library/user-event moves from 14.6.7 to 14.6.8, and pnpm-lock.yaml is regenerated to match (new resolution hash, updated importer and snapshot entries). The lockfile refresh also picks up deprecation notices on two OpenTelemetry trace packages that are unrelated to the bump. No application source, runtime behaviour or production dependency changes.
